correctness.rationale: For all n>=5 and real positive spoke weights, the 2D radial block has eigenvalues 1±sqrt(1+n a²) and the Fourier block has 2 cos(2πk/n). The negative radial eigenvalue intersects exactly one negative Fourier eigenvalue at each a_k. The rank of two point-evaluations in each eigenspace gives the gcd baseline, and comparing separate versus merged ranks gives the single exceptional mode unless exp(2π i kd/n)=-1. Positive local losses annihilate exactly the orthogonal dark invariant subspace, proving the long-time capture projector for arbitrary positive rates. The supplementary finite arithmetic program passed 5,194 two-prime rank checks and 16 exact rational tests plus nine exact quadratic-field tests at two irrational resonances; these are corroboration, not the universal proof.

The exact additional dark mode at a discrete spoke-weight/Fourier resonance, its phase exception for every absorber spacing, and the consequent obstruction to complete two-rim capture at all interior resonances are not covered by a cited identical or stronger theorem. value.rationale: This is a complete all-size, all-spoke-coupling classification of the transport-accessible subspace of a natural wheel network with two local absorbers. It identifies finitely many explicit spectral engineering values at which a new protected dark mode appears, determines the exact arithmetic condition for avoidance, and proves that no rim pair can eliminate the obstruction at an interior resonance. These placement and coupling limits have a direct physical interpretation in quantum trapping and are not merely a renamed cycle formula or an isolated finite computation.
